6 Best Free Things to do in Milwaukee in the Summer

Loading Todays Quote Form...
Home   »   Blog   »  Portable Storage News   »   6 Best Free Things to do in Milwaukee in the Summer
Get Creative with UNITS® Michael McAlhany Tips Moving and Portable Storage Advice Moving and Storage Advice Network Article Portable Storage News Uncategorized

Published: August 08, 2019

The Summer is full of fun activities, especially when you live in a city. However, when you live in the city, enjoying summertime activities can really strain your budget. Luckily when you live in Milwaukee, there are plenty of Summer activities that you can enjoy for free! Whether you’ve just moved to Milwaukee or have been a long time resident, here are some free Summer activities anyone can enjoy.

At UNITS Moving & Portable Storage of Milwaukee, our goal is to help our customers with every step of the moving experience. If you are planning your move to Milwaukee, UNITS Moving & Portable Storage of Milwaukee can help make your relocation easier. Our patented watertight UNITS containers are the solution to making moving easy! To get a free quote on our portable storage containers, call us at (262) 214-5124 today! To find the things you can do for free in Milwaukee in the summer, check out our suggestions below:

Free Outdoor Concerts

Milwaukee is known for its bustling music scene. Every summer, nearly every Milwaukee neighborhood hosts an outdoor-concert series that feature local bands and talent. The most well known are Bay View’s “Chill on the Hill” and “Jazz in the Park” which is hosted in downtown Milwaukee. 

Spend Time at the Beach

When you think of summer, one of the first things that come to mind is spending time relaxing on the beach. Luckily for you Lake Michigan offers miles and miles of white sandy dunes and crystal clear water to enjoy.

Shakespeare in the Park

If you are a fan of plays, you know that attending a Shakespeare show can really burn a hole in your pocket. However, if you live in Milwaukee, you don’t have to pay to see your favorite Shakespeare plays.Thanks to the Optimist Theater, Milwaukee residents can enjoy professional theatrical performances of Shakespeare’s plays for free at the beautiful Peck Pavilion located in downtown Milwaukee.

Explore Milwaukee’s Attractions

Milwaukee offers tons of attractions to explore. While these venues often don’t cost too much for entry, the three biggest attractions in Milwaukee – the Milwaukee Art Museum, Milwaukee Public Museum and the Milwaukee County Zoo- waive admission fees once a month.

Milwaukee Night Markets

Enjoy browsing local offerings at Milwaukee’s night markets. NEWaukee, the most well known night market in Milwaukee is held on June 14, July 12, August 16 and September 13 this Summer.

Movies in the Park

Concerts and plays aren’t the only free entertainment options in Milwaukee. Residents can enjoy free movies at Milwaukee County parks. Visitors are encouraged to bring their own food and drinks as well as blankets and chairs.
